review.title: Install Xcode on the QA machine now, or wait for TP-1475?
review.question: QA can't build the Mac app because the QA machine lacks Xcode, and TP-1475 (Install Xcode on the QA machine) is filed to fix it. Should Symphony wait for TP-1475, or will you install Xcode yourself now?
review.why:
TP-1457 passed QA on the live server, but the next Mac app QA pass needs Xcode.

It comes from the status report on 11 November 21:00 to 12 November 03:00 UTC.
review.if_unanswered: TP-1475 runs in its turn, and every Mac app QA pass waits for it.

options.label: Wait for TP-1475
options.effect: TP-1475 installs Xcode in its turn; Mac app QA passes wait until it lands.

tradeoffs.text: Mac app QA waits about an hour.

options.label: I'll install it now
options.effect: You install Xcode on the QA machine; TP-1475 is cancelled once QA builds again.

tradeoffs.text: Ten minutes of your time on the QA machine.

review.recommendation_reason: TP-1475 is next in line, so waiting costs little and needs nothing from you.
